items.title: Gas supply cut from Indonesia accounts for less than 2% of Singapore’s daily gas demand: EMA
items.snippet: The authority has contingency plans in place to deal with such reductions

items.title: Reduction in Indonesia gas supply amounts to less than 2% of Singapore’s total daily demand: EMA
items.snippet: Singapore's Energy Market Authority also said that it had contingency plans in place to deal with such reductions.

items.title: Indonesia reduces gas exports to Singapore in order to 'safeguard reliability' of domestic supplies
items.snippet: Indonesia's diversion of exports to meet domestic needs involves 31 million standard cubic feet of natural gas a day from Natuna and Sumatra, Indonesia’s upstream oil and gas regulator told CNA.

items.title: Indonesia begins cutting natural gas exports to Singapore from Oct 24: reports
items.snippet: The cut is equivalent to about 8% of the pipeline gas Indonesia exported to Singapore in 2024

items.title: Gas supply cut from Indonesia accounts for less than 2% of S’pore’s daily gas demand: EMA
items.snippet: Singapore has also been moving to further diversify its energy sources.

items.title: Singapore launches S$143 million initiative to help industries cut emissions
items.snippet: Three companies have also been approved to import and supply biomethane, a renewable alternative to natural gas, as Singapore explores ways to help industries decarbonise.

items.title: Google Cloud services largely restored in UK; Revolut services back up in Singapore
items.snippet: A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London disrupted several UK banks and Revolut services, including in Singapore.
